main.description: Served by the community service. Writes a verification record into the run's community repo, with the caller as reviewer. The caller authenticates with a service-auth JWT from their own PDS and must be an active, unbanned moderator of that community who is not a runner on the run.

run.description: The run, pinned to the version the moderator reviewed.

reason.description: Required when rejecting or requesting changes.

verifiedTimes.description: A retime; only with status verified.

errors.name: RunNotFound
errors.description: The run is not in the index yet, or was deleted.

errors.name: RunChanged
errors.description: The run was edited after the moderator opened it.

errors.name: RunInvalid
errors.description: The run fails its category's checks, so it cannot be verified.

errors.name: NotModerator
errors.description: The caller is not an active moderator of the run's community.

errors.name: OwnRun
errors.description: Moderators cannot judge runs they ran in.

errors.name: CommunityNotManaged
errors.description: The community service holds no session for this community.
